title: An amazing experience in Barcelona!
text:

title: Excellent experience with Chef Victor and his wife Kiera.
text:
Chef Victor and his wife Kiera were wonderful.
We had great instructions on how to get there, a wonderful greeting, excellent conversation, great food and drink, great information about Barcelona and overall a super enjoyable experience. 
Future trips to Barcelona would not be complete without a visit with Chef Victor and Kiera. Thx again sooooooo much !!!!

title: Entertaining evening with excellent hosts
text: We had a wonderful evening with Victor and Kira. Unfortunately far too short. We would have liked to hear even more of Victor's stories. We had a lot of fun, but above all an excellent meal. The paella was uniquely good. We can highly recommend both of them.
author: P3492TCmartinaf

title: Excellent Paella Experience
text: This was one of the best experiences we had during our 16 days in Europe. The hosts (Victor and Kirra) were welcoming, we had so wonderful conversations, learned some history about Barcelona, and the food and drinks were excellent! I came home with the passion to recreate our dining experience. If you have an opportunity to experience this. I highly recommend it.
author: Sandra_W

title: Outstanding BBQ experience with a personal touch in Barcelona
text:
The BBQ Experience in Barcelona was an all-around successful experience. We were welcomed very warmly and felt comfortable from the very beginning. The food was outstanding – freshly prepared, high quality, and top-notch in taste.
We also particularly liked the interesting information and insights about Barcelona, which made the whole thing even more personal. In addition, our wishes and needs were very well addressed.
Absolutely recommended for everyone who appreciates good food and a pleasant atmosphere.
author: joergl787
